Falls ja, welche Nachweise sind hierfür im Rahmen des Teilnahmeantrags bzw. Angebots erforderlich? Nein, neben festangestellten Mitarbeitenden können keine freien Mitarbeitende berücksichtigt werden (Dokument Erklärung zur Eignung, Punkt 2.2.1 Mitarbeiter) Sollten die geforderten personellen Eignungen mit den eigenen festangestellten Mitarbeitenden nicht vollständig erfüllt werden können, besteht die Möglichkeit, • eine Bietergemeinschaft zu bilden oder • eine Eignungsleihe in Anspruch zu nehmen. Die jeweils erforderlichen Nachweise sind dann gemäß den Vorgaben der Vergabeunterlagen im Angebot beizubringen. Anhaenge, Seite: 2 lfd. Eine darüberhinausgehende ausführliche Ausarbeitung ist nicht erforderlich. Die Bieter sollen jedoch erkennen lassen, welche übergeordnete kommunikative Idee den drei Assets zugrunde liegt und wie diese miteinander zusammenhängen. Aus einer pfx-Datei können die benötigten Zertifikate mit folgendem Befehlen erstellt werden: Schlüssel als pem extrahieren: $ openssl pkcs12 -in <PFX_file> -nocerts -nodes -out verwaltungsportal1_key.pem RSA Key nochmal nach .key konvertieren openssl rsa -in verwaltungsportal1_key.pem -out verwaltungsportal1.key Public Certificate extrahieren: $ openssl pkcs12 -in <PFX_file> -clcerts -nokeys -out verwaltungsportal_cert.crt CA Chain extrahieren: $ openssl pkcs12 -in <PFX_file> -cacerts -nokeys -chain verwaltungsportal_ca.crt Die Dateien müssen auf den Server übertragen werden und ersetzen folgende Dateien: (definiert sind diese in /etc/httpd/conf.d/ssl.conf) • SSLCertificateFile /etc/pki/tls/certs/verwaltungsportal.crt • SSLCertificateKeyFile /etc/pki/tls/private/verwaltungsportal1.key • SSLCACertificateFile /etc/pki/tls/certs/verwaltungsportal-ca.crt Nach Überschreiben reload der Konfiguration. 4.3.5 Konfiguration SSO Für die Installation des Singl

===== FILE: files/world_bank_procurement_notice_OP00471479.html =====

EAST AFRICAN COMMUNITY

 

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES - FIRMS SELECTION)

Project Name: Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (EARSPforR)

Project ID: P176371

Assignment Title: Consultancy Services for Development of Animated Video Content with Infographics, Data Visualizations and Voice-over Narration for EAC Online Statistics Learning Materials

Reference No.: TZ-EAC-564358-CS-CQS

1. BACKGROUND

The East African Community (EAC) Secretariat is implementing the EAC component of the Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (EARSPforR), with financing from the World Bank. The Program seeks to strengthen the production, harmonization, dissemination, and use of quality economic and social statistics in Eastern Africa.

Under EARSPforR, the EAC Secretariat has developed online learning materials in fourteen priority statistical domains for use by Partner State institutions and other data users. Although technically sound, many of the materials are text-heavy an

. The videos will incorporate infographics, accurate data visualizations, professional voice-over narration, captions, and transcripts, and will be suitable for the EAC Learning Management System, websites, and mobile access.

The assignment will be completed within a maximum of ten weeks from contract commencement. The principal deliverables will include an inception report and production plan; scripts, storyboards, and visual style; a pilot video; a complete draft video package; and final master, LMS/mobile, caption, transcript, thumbnail, editable-source-file, asset/licence, and completion-report packages.

The detailed Terms of Reference for the assignment can be accessed at www.eac.int under Procurement/Consultancies.

2. QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

learner engagement, accessibility, and understanding, particularly among non-specialist audiences.

The Secretariat intends to engage a qualified consulting firm to develop new multimedia content where explanation gaps exist and to transform selected approved learning materials into concise animated videos. The videos will incorporate infographics, accurate data visualizations, professional voice-over narration, captions, and transcripts, and will be suitable for the EAC Learning Management System, websites, and mobile access.

The assignment will be completed within a maximum of ten weeks from contract commencement. The principal deliverables will include an inception report and production plan; scripts, storyboards, and visual style; a pilot video; a complete draft video package; and final master, LMS/mobile, caption, transcript, thumbnail, editable-source-file, asset/licence, and completion-report packages.

deadline_authority.rule: Only dates locally attached to tender/bid/quotation submission or requests-to-participate language can automatically resolve bid timing. Query/clarification dates are never accepted as submission deadlines. Missing/ambiguous submission evidence remains review-required before FINAL_SUPER_GREEN.

items.review_contract: Gate-ready authoritative DCE evidence pack from the current DCE generation. Unknown is never PASS. FINAL_SUPER_GREEN requires every mandatory gate resolved and authoritative deadline reconciliation.

ranking_contract: Recall-first discovery; post-DCE SPM-fit reranking only. Approximately 80% priority lane + 20% evidence-quality exploration lane. No candidate is declared eligible by this rank.
instruction: Review SPM_PRIORITY HOT/GOOD items first, then exploration. These are authoritative DCE evidence packs, not final verdicts. Unknown is never PASS.
